newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF's Mitsuzuka denies report of impropriety.
newsitem.headline: MOF's Mitsuzuka denies report of impropriety.

text.p: Japan's Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka on Wednesday denied a newspaper report that he received improper contributions from a stock speculator sentenced for manipulating stock prices.
"The report is completely groundless," Mitsuzuka said.

The Mainichi Shimbun and a Japanese tabloid reported on Wednesday that a witness testifying in a court case involving a stock speculator had made allegations of financial impropriety against Mitsuzuka.
Mitsuzuka said he did not know about the case or the witness reported to have testified.

"It is even doubtful if such testimony was actually given," he said. "I will take countermeasures, civil and criminal, against the court witness and the two newspaper companies after an investigation," he said.
